release.changeNote: Make advertised model capabilities reachable. Kling 3.0 video elements move to their own always-active input mode so a run that attaches them is quotable at all (they previously sat in the elements-conditioned references mode, which this surface never enters, making every such run fail validation). The Seedance 2 family's reference-duration constraint is rebuilt so 2.5 carries the 30-second budget its 30-second output implies while its siblings stay at 15. Provider ids, pricing, adapters, and availability are unchanged.
